description: This file contains custom plotting classes and functions for pandas-on-Spark integration with matplotlib, including plot type classes (e.g., bar, box, hist, pie, kde), helper functions for plotting, and compatibility handling for different matplotlib versions.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkBarPlot
classes.description: Custom bar plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasBarPlot and TopNPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkBoxPlot
classes.description: Custom box plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasBoxPlot and BoxPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkHistPlot
classes.description: Custom histogram plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasHistPlot and HistogramPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkPiePlot
classes.description: Pie plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasPiePlot and TopNPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkAreaPlot
classes.description: Area plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasAreaPlot and SampledPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkLinePlot
classes.description: Line plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasLinePlot and SampledPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkBarhPlot
classes.description: Horizontal bar plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasBarhPlot and TopNPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkScatterPlot
classes.description: Scatter plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasScatterPlot and TopNPlotBase.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkKdePlot
classes.description: KDE plot class for pandas-on-Spark, extends PandasKdePlot and KdePlotBase.

methods.name: _set_ticklabels
methods.description: Helper function to set tick labels on axes, handling repeated ticks due to FixedLocator.

methods.name: boxplot
methods.description: Method to create box plots with custom styling and handling for pandas-on-Spark data.

methods.name: _compute_plot_data
methods.description: Method to compute data for boxplot from pandas-on-Spark Series or DataFrame.

methods.name: _make_plot
methods.description: Method to generate the plot for boxplot, including handling of fliers and labels.

methods.name: rc_defaults
methods.description: Static method to get default rcParams for boxplot styling.

methods.name: _args_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts arguments for histogram plotting, converting to numpy array if needed.

methods.name: _calculate_bins
methods.description: Returns the bins for histogram plotting.

methods.name: _plot
methods.description: Static method to plot histogram data, handling stacking and bin counts.

methods.name: _make_plot_keywords
methods.description: Prepares plot keyword arguments for histogram plotting.

methods.name: _plot
methods.description: Main function to generate plots based on data, x, y, and plot kind.

methods.name: plot_pandas_on_spark
methods.description: Main function to select and create pandas-on-Spark plots based on data type and kind.

methods.name: plot_series
methods.description: Function to create plots for pandas-on-Spark Series, supporting various plot kinds.

methods.name: plot_frame
methods.description: Function to create plots for pandas-on-Spark DataFrame, supporting various plot kinds.
